changelog: Novidades: login com o carro (BMW Apps) agora acontece dentro do DriveHub — o app completa sozinho o handshake de segurança SAS pelo túnel USB. O app BMW Connected Classic (6.4.x) vira o assinador de segurança invisível em segundo plano (você nunca precisa abri-lo). O diagnóstico mostra as novas etapas: certificado, desafio do carro, assinatura e login concluído. Protocolo BMW Apps baseado no código aberto BimmerGestalt AAIdrive e IDriveConnectKit (licença MIT).
changelogEn:
What's new:
- Car login (BMW Apps) now happens inside DriveHub: the app completes the SAS security handshake on its own over the USB tunnel.
- The BMW Connected Classic app (6.4.x) becomes the invisible background security signer — you never need to open it.
- The diagnostics show the new steps: certificate, car challenge, signature, and completed login.
- BMW Apps protocol built on the open-source BimmerGestalt AAIdrive and IDriveConnectKit code (MIT license).
